newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Cobepa looks to Netherlands for growth.
newsitem.headline: Cobepa looks to Netherlands for growth.

text.p: Belgian holding company Compagnie Benelux Paribas SA (Cobepa) said on Tuesday it expected to continue expanding in the Netherlands in 1997 and 1998 after strong growth in 1996.

Cobepa Managing Director Christian Varin told a news conference on the group's 1996 results that Dutch companies now accounted for 13.13 percent of its investment portfolio, up from 9.55 percent at the end of 1995.
"This (growth) will probably continue this year and next," Varin said.

In 1996, Cobepa, via its Dutch Paribas Deelnemingen NV unit, bought 25 percent of Dutch family-owned food producer Sens Label, 25 percent of heating and sanitary equipment distributor Vegro and 20 percent of Applebee, a food restaurant franchise business, modelled on the U.S. company of the same name, which is due to launch soon.
Varin said Cobepa was also emphasising investments in unlisted, family-owned businesses because studies had shown that statistically these offered the highest growth potential.
Cobepa is a unit of French Cie Financiere Paribas.
